TITLE: Hyperbolic Liquid-Opal Cathedral
DESCRIPTION: Glides down an infinite 3D Kleinian-inspired vaulted fractal cathedral whose obsidian and burnished-gold ribs are draped in curl-rippled liquid-opal mercury, bathed in volumetric prismatic stained-glass god-rays and 4-tap ambient occlusion. Features 12 live-wired controls across 4 UI groups, 5 factory presets, and a deterministic beat-synced QuickJS script.

CONTROLS.NAME: speed
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Bipolar nave flythrough velocity; negative values glide backward down the infinite vaulted aisle.

CONTROLS.NAME: audioDrive
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Scales FFT coupling into stained-glass shaft pulsing, gold-vein luminescence, and obsidian canal rails.

CONTROLS.NAME: foldMorph
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Morphs the 4-iteration Kleinian box-fold tracery ribs carved into the cathedral walls and vaults.

CONTROLS.NAME: ribScale
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adjusts nave column thickness and gyroid liquid-opal surface relief depth across the obsidian stone.

CONTROLS.NAME: mirrorNave
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Mirrors the cathedral vertically into an impossible Escher-like dual-vault reflection.

CONTROLS.NAME: opalSheen
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Thin-film liquid-opal Fresnel iridescence draped over obsidian arches and the floor canal.

CONTROLS.NAME: godRays
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Density of diagonal volumetric stained-glass clerestory light shafts descending through the nave.

CONTROLS.NAME: accentTint
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Palette phase and stained-glass accent tint for volumetric god-rays and gilded gothic ribs.

CONTROLS.NAME: intensity
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Master HDR exposure into ACES filmic tone mapping.

CONTROLS.NAME: strobeGate
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Arms beat-locked clerestory strobe pulses synchronized to syn_BPM.

CONTROLS.NAME: vaultPulse
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Momentary energy wave surging forward along the obsidian floor canal and gothic arches.

CONTROLS.NAME: look
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: 2D camera pan (X) and clerestory pitch (Y) inside the gothic fractal nave.

PRESETS.NAME: Default
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: Classic obsidian-and-gold hyperbolic cathedral with balanced liquid-opal sheen and stained-glass god-rays.

PRESETS.NAME: Deep Warehouse
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: Dark obsidian crypt crawl with heavy monolithic columns, dramatic shafts, and deep crimson-gold veins.

PRESETS.NAME: Peak-Time Strobe
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: High-speed Escher dual-vault reflection with beat-locked clerestory strobe and hyper-folded fractal tracery.

PRESETS.NAME: Iridescent Dream
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: Gentle reverse glide looking upward into pastel liquid-opal vaults drenched in soft prismatic shafts.

PRESETS.NAME: Sub-Bass Minimal
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: Clean architectural ribs and subtle tracery emphasizing bass-reactive electric rails along the dark canal.
